reason: shadcn's chart.tsx is a themed wrapper (ChartContainer, ChartStyle, ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegendContent) around recharts, a React-only library whose charts are drawn by React components that register in a redux store from effects. (1) shadcn-port R14 asks for a pinned JS equivalent behind a Stimulus controller; it is NOT followed because the maintainer constraint of the adoption epic is no third-party JavaScript (the same constraint as sonner) and because recharts renders an EMPTY wrapper under react-dom renderToStaticMarkup (measured by dev/spikes/chart: its items register in useEffect, which never runs on the server), so a vendored engine could not produce server-rendered charts at all. Instead the chart is a Phlex SVG that emits the DOM recharts 3.8 produces after the browser settles (class names, group order, attributes), the math recharts uses (getNiceTickValues, band/point scales, stacks, curveMonotoneX and the other d3-shape curves, sectors) is ported to Ruby, and the behavior (tooltip, cursor, keyboard, legend) is the small chadcn--chart controller reading data-* attributes. The spike reproduces the stacked bar and monotone line DOM with a largest numeric deviation of 0.0 px (decision record: dev/decisions/chart.md). (2) initial_dimension sizing: recharts' ResponsiveContainer measures its parent and re-lays out the chart on every resize; the server cannot measure, so ChartContainer lays the chart out ONCE at initial_dimension (default 320x200, the shadcn default) and draws it at that pixel size (.recharts-wrapper width/height in px, the DOM recharts writes at that container size), so the chart does not follow the container size and nothing is recomputed on resize (the host chooses the size with initial_dimension:), and G2 compares at a container fixed to the initial dimension. (3) No animation: recharts animates the first paint (isAnimationActive 'auto', 400 to 1500 ms); the Phlex chart renders the final state and never animates (isAnimationActive is accepted and ignored), and the oracle renders with isAnimationActive false so both sides compare the settled state. (4) JSON-only scenarios: the parity scenarios are JSON trees rendered by both harnesses, which cannot carry React elements or functions, so a chart scenario is data: the shadcn layer is named by its export (ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartLegend, ChartStyle; the contents are the value of content) and the recharts parts are harness-scoped _-prefixed nodes (_BarChart, _Bar, _XAxis, _Label ...) resolved by a probes module on the React side and by ShadcnParity::TreeRenderer#harness_scope on the Phlex side; functions (tickFormatter, labelFormatter, formatter) are expressed as the named formatters of the spec ({formatter: slice, args: [start, end]} = JS String#slice and Ruby slicing with the same clamping as JS String#slice (spec: Named formatters), locale, percent; Ruby kwarg form {slice: [start, end]}), the Ruby classes also accept any callable. (5) Text measurement: recharts measures labels, the legend box and the tooltip with the DOM (getStringSize, getBoundingClientRect); the server assumes a 16px line box and 0.6em glyph width (kwargs on ChartContainer) and chadcn--chart re-runs the label-collision and tooltip-position passes with the measured values after fonts are ready (labels the server hid ship in inert tickTemplate elements the controller mounts, never toggled, because recharts omits hidden ticks and G2 compares the tree exactly), so the compared attributes are those of the settled DOM at the pinned font. (6) Tooltip: ChartTooltipContent is rendered once per category index as an inert template (server, per-index) and the controller shows the one for the active index; the position of the tooltip wrapper (style, -top/-right class modifiers) is the controller's output and excluded from G2. (7) Legend height: Chart::Legend legend_height: is the server's assumption for the measured legend box (default 28 = pt-3 + one 16px line); chadcn--chart re-measures but does not recompute the plot when it differs. (8) Behavior not ported: ref, onClick/onMouseMove style callbacks as props (events instead), custom React-element content (content={<Custom/>}), Brush, ReferenceLine/ReferenceArea/ErrorBar, syncId, Customized, and every prop that takes a React element or function other than the named formatters. Cartesian tooltip (item #48): the tooltip is drawn for the axis event type only (one template per category); `shared: false` (item tooltips of a bar chart) is accepted and not drawn, because recharts 3.8 writes the item index only on Pie sectors (spec, Behavior). The wrapper's position (`transform`) is left to the controller, since it depends on the measured size of the content. Parity runs at text_height 18 (the shared parity page is not font-pinned and recharts measures tick text 18px high there; ShadcnParity::ChartScope::PAGE_TEXT_HEIGHT); the gem default 16 is unit-tested (text_height_test.rb), not G2-gated, until the runner page is pinned for chart scenarios. Controller (item #50): the post-font-load re-measure pass of (5) is NOT built yet (no axes value, no tickTemplate children: the server's assumed metrics decide which tick labels exist; spec, Behavior, Re-measure pass); the tooltip interaction (pointer, touch, click trigger, keyboard, Escape, default_index precedence, placement, cursor and active dots, Turbo cache) is. The Phlex chart handles axis tooltips only, so the item event type (pie, shared: false) is not wired in the controller. A chart outside a Chart::Container is not wired (no controller element to carry the values).
api: Chart::Container initial_dimension: lays the chart out once and draws it at that pixel size; there is no ResponsiveContainer re-layout or scaling on resize
isAnimationActive and every animation* prop of the series are accepted and ignored: the settled state is rendered (the tooltip wrapper keeps recharts' own 400 ms transform transition)
tick_formatter:, label_formatter:, formatter: accept a callable or a named formatter (slice, locale, percent) instead of a JavaScript function; React-element content is not supported
Chart::Tooltip content is rendered per category index as an inert template and swapped by chadcn--chart; tooltip position and wrapper class modifiers are computed in the browser
Chart::Legend legend_height: is the server's assumption for the measured legend box (default 28 = pt-3 + one 16px line); chadcn--chart re-measures but does not recompute the plot when it differs

Chart naming (naming-conventions R2, open for the maintainer): chart names keep the Chart suffix (Chart::BarChart, not Chart::Bar) because Chart::Bar, Line, Area, Pie, Radar and RadialBar are the series classes of the same React names; de-stuttering would make two React exports share one Ruby constant
Chart::Container text_height: and text_char_width: are the server's assumptions for DOM text measurement (16 and 0.6em)
Chart::Config is a Hash of key => { label:, icon:, color: or theme: { light:, dark: } } (ChartConfig); icon is a component instance instead of a React component type
Brush, ReferenceLine, ReferenceArea, ErrorBar, Customized, syncId, ref and mouse/touch callback props are not ported
Chart::Tooltip::Content and Chart::Legend::Content accept **attrs on their root div (shadcn-port R6); React's ChartTooltipContent/ChartLegendContent do not spread props

Chart::Cell renders nothing itself (recharts Cell is () => null) but, as in recharts, its props are spread into the parent's shape at its index: it accepts **attrs (class: included) like every part and the parent lands them on that sector or rectangle (no R6 exception)
Chart::Style takes no attrs: it renders a bare <style> like ChartStyle
Chart::Tooltip and Chart::Legend class: and attrs are a chadcn addition on .recharts-tooltip-wrapper / .recharts-legend-wrapper (recharts has no className there)

Chart::Tooltip item_sorter:, separator: and content_style: are accepted and ignored with Chart::Tooltip::Content: recharts applies itemSorter, separator and contentStyle only inside DefaultTooltipContent (not ported), a custom content gets the payload unsorted; likewise Chart::Legend icon_size:, icon_type: and inactive_color: are ignored by Legend::Content
Chart::Tooltip formatter: / label_formatter: set on the Tooltip override the ones of its content: (recharts cloneElements the content with the Tooltip props)

Chart::Style raises ArgumentError for an id or config key outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] and for a color containing < > { } ; \ or /*, where React's ChartStyle interpolates any key and color into the style text untouched (ruby-gem-conventions R12)

Parity gate G2b (parity_run.mjs --dx helpers) is not run for chart until the tree renderer supports the harness-scoped _ nodes in its helpers mode (item #47); the helper path is covered by the unit test meanwhile

Chart::Tooltip active:, trigger:, offset:, allow_escape_view_box:, reverse_direction:, position:, wrapper_style: and the animation kwargs reach the browser as Stimulus values on div[data-slot=chart]; Tooltip portal:, use_translate3d:, item_style:, label_style: and the default contents DefaultTooltipContent / DefaultLegendContent are not ported

allow_tokens lists plain words of the ArgumentError messages in chart/scale/band.rb and chart/scale/linear.rb ("domain: and range: take two values each", "range: takes two values") that the G1 token scan reads as Tailwind classes because the static gate scans every file under lib/chadcn/chart; they are not class tokens
